official_scope: stellar evolution in normal & starburst galaxies
design_notes: Concept density varies by topic: stellar evolution/compact remnants and object identification are the densest because they carry the most official-scope case-study content. Stellar classification and spectral concepts are kept atomic so spectral typing, luminosity class, and H-R placement can each trigger their own clinics. Distance-ladder, orbital/rotation, and radiation calculations are split into separate method concepts to avoid oversized math guides. Object-list concepts cover every official object without over-splitting subfeatures beyond M82 X-1/X-2/SN 2014J and GW170817.

concepts.title: OBAFGKM spectral type sequence
concepts.description: Sequence stars by spectral type from hottest to coolest and predict dominant absorption features for each temperature class.

concepts.title: Spectral absorption line formation
concepts.description: Relate stellar absorption lines to elements and ionization states in the photosphere and identify temperature-sensitive lines such as Balmer hydrogen and Ca II.

concepts.title: Luminosity class and pressure broadening
concepts.description: Distinguish dwarfs, giants, and supergiants from line widths caused by pressure broadening and assign MK luminosity classes.

concepts.title: Blackbody continuum in stellar spectra
concepts.description: Interpret the shape and peak of a stellar continuum to estimate effective temperature without performing Wien law calculations.

concepts.title: H-R diagram axes and stellar regions
concepts.description: Read an H-R diagram to locate the main sequence, giant/supergiant branches, and white dwarf region from luminosity and temperature.

concepts.title: Metallicity from spectral lines
concepts.description: Determine stellar metallicity by comparing metal absorption line strengths and explain how metal content affects line ratios.

concepts.title: Peculiar stellar spectra
concepts.description: Recognize emission-line stars, Be stars, and Wolf-Rayet features in spectra and infer circumstellar or wind activity from spectral anomalies.

concepts.title: Color index and photometric temperature
concepts.description: Use broadband color indices such as B-V to estimate stellar temperature and identify reddening from color excess.

concepts.title: MK spectral classification procedure
concepts.description: Apply the Morgan-Keenan classification procedure by assigning a spectral class, luminosity class, and peculiarity tag from an observed spectrum.

topics.title: Stellar evolution, variables, and compact remnants

concepts.title: Main sequence hydrogen burning and lifetimes
concepts.description: Explain why stars spend most of their lives on the main sequence and estimate relative lifetimes from mass-luminosity scaling.

concepts.title: Low/intermediate-mass post-main-sequence evolution
concepts.description: Trace red giant, helium flash, horizontal branch, AGB, planetary nebula, and white dwarf stages for stars below roughly eight solar masses.

concepts.title: High-mass star evolution and core collapse
concepts.description: Describe shell burning toward an iron core and the core-collapse endpoint for massive stars.

concepts.title: Cepheid variable pulsation
concepts.description: Explain Cepheid variability through the instability strip and relate pulsation period to luminosity class without deriving distance calibration.

concepts.title: RR Lyrae variables
concepts.description: Identify RR Lyrae as low-metallicity horizontal-branch pulsators with nearly constant luminosity and periods under one day.

concepts.title: Type Ia supernova mechanism
concepts.description: Explain white dwarf accretion or merger-induced thermonuclear detonation producing a Type Ia supernova light curve and spectra.

concepts.title: Core-collapse supernova types
concepts.description: Distinguish Type II, Ib, and Ic supernovae by hydrogen and helium line signatures and their core-collapse progenitor stars.

concepts.title: Neutron stars and pulsars
concepts.description: Describe neutron star formation, spin-down pulsar emission, and observable pulse periods from rotating magnetic fields.

concepts.title: Stellar-mass black holes and X-ray binaries
concepts.description: Explain accretion-powered X-ray binary signatures and infer black hole candidates from companion star orbital motion.

concepts.title: Ultraluminous X-ray sources
concepts.description: Explain ULXs as accreting compact objects exceeding the Eddington limit for stellar-mass black holes and distinguish neutron star from intermediate-mass black hole candidates.

concepts.title: Compact object mergers and gravitational waves
concepts.description: Relate gravitational-wave chirp signals to neutron star and black hole mergers and identify possible electromagnetic counterpart channels.

concepts.title: Supernova remnants and nucleosynthesis
concepts.description: Recognize supernova remnant expansion shells and connect heavy-element production to supernova ejecta.

topics.title: Normal galaxy morphology and stellar populations

concepts.title: Hubble tuning fork classification
concepts.description: Classify galaxies as elliptical, lenticular, spiral, barred spiral, or irregular using the Hubble sequence and note correlations with gas content.

concepts.title: Galaxy disk, bulge, halo, bar, and ring components
concepts.description: Identify disk, bulge, halo, bar, and ring structures in galaxy images and describe their stellar and gas content differences.

concepts.title: Stellar populations I and II
concepts.description: Compare Population I and Population II stars by age, metallicity, location, and orbit to interpret galaxy color and structure.

concepts.title: Spiral arms and density wave theory
concepts.description: Explain spiral arm formation by density waves and relate arm regions to star formation and blue OB associations.

concepts.title: Elliptical galaxy properties
concepts.description: Describe elliptical galaxies as red, gas-poor, pressure-supported systems with old stars and little ongoing star formation.

concepts.title: Irregular galaxy properties
concepts.description: Identify irregular galaxies by asymmetric structure and active or recent star formation, often triggered by interactions.

concepts.title: Globular clusters and galaxy halos
concepts.description: Use globular cluster ages, metallicities, and spatial distribution to probe galaxy halos and early formation history.

concepts.title: Galaxy surface brightness profiles
concepts.description: Distinguish de Vaucouleurs and exponential surface brightness profiles for ellipticals and disk galaxies from brightness versus radius plots.

concepts.title: Galaxy color-morphology relation
concepts.description: Interpret the bimodal red sequence and blue cloud in color-magnitude diagrams and relate color to galaxy morphology and quenching.

concepts.title: Galaxy luminosity and mass-to-light ratio
concepts.description: Estimate stellar mass from luminosity and mass-to-light ratio and compare stellar versus dynamical mass contributions.

concepts.title: Starburst definition and rate thresholds
concepts.description: Define a starburst by star formation rate per unit gas mass or short gas depletion time and distinguish starbursts from normal star-forming galaxies.

concepts.title: Star formation rate indicators
concepts.description: Compare H-alpha, ultraviolet, infrared, and radio continuum tracers of star formation and correct for dust attenuation.

concepts.title: Starburst triggers from interactions
concepts.description: Explain how tidal encounters, gas inflows, and bar instabilities compress gas and trigger concentrated star formation.

concepts.title: Super star clusters in starbursts
concepts.description: Identify super star clusters as compact massive young clusters and infer young ages and high star formation rate densities from their luminosities.

concepts.title: Starburst galactic winds and outflows
concepts.description: Describe starburst-driven winds from supernovae and massive stars and recognize outflow signatures in absorption and emission lines.

concepts.title: Galaxy merger stages and tidal features
concepts.description: Identify tidal tails, bridges, and shells as merger signatures and infer interaction stage from galaxy morphology.

concepts.title: Tidal disruption rings and induced bars
concepts.description: Explain how close encounters form rings, bars, or nuclear gas flows through tidal torques and resonances.

concepts.title: Dusty luminous and ultraluminous infrared galaxies
concepts.description: Relate LIRG and ULIRG infrared luminosity to dust-obscured starbursts and frequent ongoing mergers.

concepts.title: Starburst spectral signatures
concepts.description: Recognize strong narrow emission lines, young stellar continuum, and Wolf-Rayet features in starburst galaxy spectra.

concepts.title: Star formation efficiency and Kennicutt-Schmidt law
concepts.description: Apply the Kennicutt-Schmidt relation between gas surface density and star formation rate surface density to starburst and normal galaxies.

topics.title: Distance ladder and extragalactic distance indicators

concepts.title: Parallax distance measurement
concepts.description: Calculate distance from trigonometric parallax angles and explain baseline limitations for galactic and extragalactic scales.

concepts.title: Distance modulus equation
concepts.description: Apply m - M = 5 log d - 5 to relate apparent magnitude, absolute magnitude, and distance in parsecs.

concepts.title: Spectroscopic parallax
concepts.description: Determine stellar distance by matching a star's spectrum and luminosity class to an H-R diagram absolute magnitude.

concepts.title: Cepheid period-luminosity relation
concepts.description: Use the Cepheid period-luminosity relation to calculate absolute magnitude and distance from an observed pulsation period.

concepts.title: RR Lyrae standard candle
concepts.description: Use RR Lyrae variables as standard candles with known absolute magnitude to find distances to old stellar populations.

concepts.title: Tip of the red giant branch distance
concepts.description: Measure the I-band luminosity of the red giant branch tip as a standard candle for nearby resolved galaxies.

concepts.title: Tully-Fisher relation
concepts.description: Apply the Tully-Fisher relation between spiral galaxy rotation velocity and luminosity to estimate extragalactic distances.

concepts.title: Type Ia supernovae as standardizable candles
concepts.description: Use Type Ia light-curve shape and color corrections to standardize peak luminosity for distance measurement.

concepts.title: Hubble law and redshift distances
concepts.description: Calculate distance from redshift using Hubble's law and identify peculiar velocity limitations at low redshift.

concepts.title: Distance ladder calibration and systematics
concepts.description: Explain how parallax calibrates Cepheids, Cepheids calibrate Type Ia supernovae, and systematic errors propagate through the ladder.

concepts.title: Kepler's third law for binaries
concepts.description: Apply Kepler's third law to determine total mass from orbital period and semimajor axis of a binary system.

concepts.title: Newtonian circular orbit velocity
concepts.description: Calculate circular orbital speed from enclosed mass and radius using v = sqrt(GM/r) and interpret its radial dependence.

concepts.title: Binary radial velocity and mass function
concepts.description: Use radial velocity curves and the mass function to set lower limits on companion masses in spectroscopic binaries.

concepts.title: Galactic rotation curve measurement
concepts.description: Measure galaxy rotation speeds from Doppler shifts of HI or CO emission and map velocity as a function of radius.

concepts.title: Rotation curve shape and dark matter inference
concepts.description: Interpret flat rotation curves beyond the visible disk as evidence for extended dark matter halos and estimate enclosed mass.

concepts.title: Oort constants and differential rotation
concepts.description: Use Oort constants A and B to describe local differential rotation and shear in the Galactic disk.

concepts.title: Virial theorem mass estimates
concepts.description: Estimate cluster or galaxy mass from velocity dispersion and size using the virial theorem relationship.

concepts.title: Escape velocity and binding
concepts.description: Calculate escape velocity from a mass distribution and distinguish bound orbits, unbound encounters, and merger outcomes.

concepts.title: Supermassive black hole mass from stellar orbits
concepts.description: Use orbital periods and semimajor axes of stars near a galaxy center to infer a central supermassive black hole mass.

concepts.title: Stefan-Boltzmann luminosity law
concepts.description: Calculate stellar luminosity from radius and effective temperature using L = 4πR²σT⁴.

concepts.title: Wien displacement law
concepts.description: Calculate peak wavelength from stellar effective temperature using λmax = b/T and interpret color-temperature relationships.

concepts.title: Inverse-square law for flux
concepts.description: Apply flux = L / (4πd²) to calculate apparent brightness from luminosity and distance.

concepts.title: Apparent magnitude scale
concepts.description: Convert flux ratios to magnitude differences using m1 - m2 = -2.5 log(F1/F2) and explain the logarithmic brightness response.

concepts.title: Absolute magnitude definition
concepts.description: Define absolute magnitude as apparent magnitude at 10 pc and use the inverse-square law to compare stellar luminosities.

concepts.title: Luminosity-radius-temperature relation
concepts.description: Compare stars on the H-R diagram using L ∝ R²T⁴ and explain giant and dwarf differences in radius and temperature.

concepts.title: Bolometric correction and band magnitudes
concepts.description: Apply bolometric corrections to convert visual or band magnitudes to bolometric luminosity and estimate total energy output.

concepts.title: Flux ratio from magnitude difference
concepts.description: Calculate flux ratios from given magnitude differences and combine magnitudes for unresolved multiple sources.

concepts.title: Andromeda (M31) identification and properties
concepts.description: Identify M31 as the nearest large spiral and interpret its disk, bulge, and satellite system in images and data.

concepts.title: Sombrero Galaxy (M104) identification
concepts.description: Identify the Sombrero Galaxy by its bright bulge and prominent dust lane, and classify its bulge, disk, and halo content.

concepts.title: Whirlpool Galaxy (M51) and companion interaction
concepts.description: Identify M51 and its companion, and explain spiral arm triggering by tidal interaction.

concepts.title: NGC 4536 starburst spiral case
concepts.description: Identify NGC 4536 as a starbursting spiral and connect its high star formation rate to H-alpha and infrared signatures.

concepts.title: MCG+07-33-027 compact starburst case
concepts.description: Identify MCG+07-33-027 as a compact starburst galaxy and interpret its emission-line and stellar population data.

concepts.title: NGC 1569 dwarf starburst with super star clusters
concepts.description: Identify NGC 1569 as a dwarf starburst hosting prominent super star clusters and outflow features.

concepts.title: Antennae Galaxies interaction
concepts.description: Identify the Antennae as a major merger and relate tidal tails, star clusters, and triggered star formation to merger stage.

concepts.title: Arp 143 collisional ring pair
concepts.description: Identify Arp 143 as an interacting pair with a ring component and explain ring formation through off-center collision.

concepts.title: Arp 147 ring galaxy pair
concepts.description: Identify Arp 147 as a collisional ring pair and use its expanding ring and blue knots to infer recent starburst activity.

concepts.title: Cartwheel Galaxy ring structure
concepts.description: Identify the Cartwheel by its outer star-forming ring, inner ring, and spokes, and explain ring expansion from a head-on collision.

concepts.title: M82 starburst and SN 2014J
concepts.description: Identify M82 as a starburst galaxy with strong winds and recognize SN 2014J as a Type Ia supernova in its disk.

concepts.title: M82 X-1 and X-2 ultraluminous X-ray sources
concepts.description: Identify M82 X-1 and X-2 as ultraluminous X-ray sources and compare black hole versus neutron star interpretations from X-ray timing.

concepts.title: GW170817 neutron star merger counterpart
concepts.description: Identify GW170817 as a binary neutron star merger with gravitational-wave and kilonova/afterglow counterparts, and connect it to r-process nucleosynthesis.

concepts.title: Terzan 5 globular cluster system
concepts.description: Identify Terzan 5 as a globular cluster with complex stellar populations and millisecond pulsars, and interpret its high stellar density data.
